candidates.name: Demar Specialties, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists toilet partitions first among its Division 10 products, offered as furnish & install or supply-only, for commercial contractors.
candidates.reason: A real Division 10 sub that installs toilet partitions and says it serves Northern/Central California and Reno, NV, with a Nevada license number (NV #0086118) on its site. It is based about 140 miles from Reno in a straight line, beyond the 120-mile regional limit, and it supplies partitions itself. That is why it is possible, not strong.
red_flags: Base about 140 mi from Reno (beyond the 120-mi regional limit), though the site names Reno, NV as a service area
Authorized distributor that sells partitions supply-only: a buy-around risk
No phone or email published on site; contact form only

candidates.name: Commercial Restroom Solutions, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: BBB lists it under the Partitions and Bathroom Remodel categories. No website, project photos or service list found.
candidates.reason: The company name and BBB 'Partitions' category point to restroom partition work, and it is about 15 miles from Carson City. But the BBB gives its service area as Douglas County only, and no website or project evidence confirms commercial partition installation.
red_flags: BBB service area listed as Douglas County, NV only
Not BBB accredited; no rating or reviews shown

license.name: Commercial Restroom Solutions, LLC
license.registry: Nevada State Contractors Board (NSCB) License & Disciplinary Search, https://app.nvcontractorsboard.com/Clients/NVSCB/Public/ContractorLicenseSearch/ContractorLicenseSearch.aspx
license.note: Nevada requires a state contractor license (NSCB). The NSCB search is an interactive ASP.NET form: you pick Search By (license number, company name or principal) and the page posts back. It can't be queried by URL, and the rules forbid submitting forms, so the license status was not checked. Look it up manually by company name. Two web searches (2026-11-20) found no published NSCB license number for this company. Its BBB profile (https://www.bbb.org/us/nv/gardnerville/profile/partition/commercial-restroom-solutions-llc-1126-90002229) lists it under Partitions, base city Gardnerville, NV, with company phone (775) 230-2106 and legal name Commercial Restroom Solutions, LLC. The profile says not BBB accredited and BBB file opened 12/13/2006. It shows no license info and no website. The company is about 50 miles south of Reno, in Douglas County.
